name: Local models
description: A client for language models that run on this computer: it finds the model servers already running here (Ollama, llama.cpp and any OpenAI-compatible server), runs .gguf model files itself with llama.cpp's llama-server, finds and downloads models from Hugging Face, lists every model with what it is, can do and needs in memory, and chats with them in threads kept as files, the answers streaming in with their speed. Chats never leave the computer: only a search or a download reaches Hugging Face.

commands.title: Local models: open
commands.description: Open Local models, on a thread when one is named.

commands.title: Local models: new chat
commands.description: Start a new chat, with a model when one is named.
